author: Chris Schommer
title: Jose Caballero swipes base, drives in run in win over Twins
desc: Jose Caballero went 1-for-3 in a win over the Twins with one stolen base, one run scored, and one RBI.
impact: Caballero has provided mixed results at the plate of late, collecting hits in five of his last 10 contests. The 29-year-old remains one of the more streaky options in the Yankees lineup for manager Aaron Boone, batting .247 with eight home runs, 29 RBI, 33 runs scored, and 20 stolen bases across 75 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jasson Dominguez chips in hit and steal in win over Twins
desc: Jasson Dominguez went 1-for-4 in a win over the Twins with one stolen base.
impact: Dominguez continues a steady stretch at the plate, collecting hits in seven of his last 10 contests. The outfielder remains one of the more underperforming bats in the Yankees lineup for manager Aaron Boone, batting .214 with three home runs, nine RBI, eight runs scored, and five stolen bases across 27 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Matt Olson crushes two homers as Braves top Mets
desc: Matt Olson went 2-for-3 in a 5-3 win over the Mets with two solo home runs and one walk.
impact: Olson continues a dynamic stretch of late, getting on base in 18 of his last 20 contests. The first baseman has offered manager Walt Weiss one of many impactful bats in an explosive Braves lineup, carrying an .883 OPS with 22 home runs, 54 RBI, 57 runs scored, and two stolen bases through 86 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Ozzie Albies goes deep in win over Mets
desc: Ozzie Albies went 1-for-4 in a win over the Mets with a solo home run.
impact: Albies continues a steady stretch of late, reaching base in 11 of his last 14 contests. The second baseman provides manager Walt Weiss another impactful option as part of a talented Braves lineup, batting .273 with 14 homers, 49 RBI, 55 runs scored, and one stolen base through 86 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Michael Harris II goes yard in win over Mets
desc: Michael Harris II went 2-for-4 in Friday's 5-3 win over the Mets with a two-run home run.
impact: Harris II continues a productive stretch of late, getting on base in 14 of his last 16 contests. The outfielder has offered manager Walt Weiss one of many impactful bats in the Braves lineup, batting .296 with 15 home runs, 46 RBI, 38 runs scored, and five stolen bases across 80 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Raisel Iglesias notches save in win over Mets
desc: Raisel Iglesias allowed one earned run on three hits while striking out over one inning to earn the save in Friday's 5-3 win over the Mets.
impact: Iglesias has offered mixed results out of the bullpen of late, allowing runs in four of his last eight trips to the mound. The right-hander remains one of the more reliable options out of an inconsistent Braves bullpen for manager Walt Weiss, posting a 1.53 ERA and 1.06 WHIP with 17 saves and a 9.8 K/9 ratio across 28 appearances.

author: Chase Davis
title: Alec Burleson cashes in four RBI as Cards crush Cubs
desc: Alec Burleson went 2-for-5 in a win over the Cubs with four RBI and one run scored.
impact: After Friday's win, Burleson is slashing .276/.342/.472 with 14 home runs, 62 RBI, 45 runs scored and two stolen bases across 84 games. The four RBI are a season high, and he's now tied for third in RBI behind teammate Jordan Walker.

author: Chase Davis
title: Masyn Winn drives in four as Cards rout Cubs
desc: Masyn Winn went 2-for-4 in Friday's 17-1 win over the Cubs with a home run, two runs scored and four RBI.
impact: Through 77 games, Winn is batting .253 with four homers, 37 RBI, 38 runs scored and seven stolen bases, along with a .302 wOBA. He's picked up multiple hits in consecutive games for the first time since mid-April, and the four RBI tie a season high.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Grant Holmes grinds through five in win over Mets
desc: Grant Holmes allowed one earned run on five hits and one walk while striking out two over five innings in Friday's 5-3 win over the Mets.
impact: Holmes has offered mixed results on the mound of late, allowing less than three earned runs in four of his last seven contests. The right-hander remains one of many steady options in the Braves rotation for manager Walt Weiss, carrying a 3.83 ERA and 1.35 WHIP with a 5-4 record and 1.9 K/BB ratio through 17 appearances.

author: Chase Davis
title: Nathan Church clubs HR, drives in three in rout of Cubs
desc: Nathan Church went 2-for-5 in Friday's 17-1 win over the Cubs with a home run, two runs scored, three RBI, and one strikeout.
impact: Through 67 games, Church is slashing .257/.298/.424 with eight homers, 28 RBI, 29 runs scored, five steals, and a .313 wOBA. He's homered in back-to-back games and in three of his last four games. He's played almost every game since returning from the IL, but he does sit against lefties every so often.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kyle Harrison labors through abbreviated outing in no-decision
desc: Kyle Harrison allowed three earned runs on five hits and one walk while striking out three over 2 2/3 innings in Friday's 7-4 win over the Diamondbacks.
impact: Harrison continues an impressive stretch on the mound, allowing two earned runs or less in 14 of his 16 trips to the mound. The left-hander has provided manager Pat Murphy with another impactful arm at the top of the Brewers rotation alongside ace Jacob Misiorowski, carrying a 2.82 ERA and 1.08 WHIP with an 8-1 record and 11.2 K/9 ratio across 16 starts.

author: Chase Davis
title: Bryan Torres pops homer off bench
desc: Bryan Torres went 1-for-2 in the win over the Cubs with a home run, one run scored and one RBI.
impact: Torres is now slashing .245/.315/.531 with four home runs, eight RBI, nine runs scored and one stolen base across 22 games. He entered the game for Masyn Winn after it was out of hand and made the Cubs pay. He's started only two of the Cardinals' last 17 games.

author: Chase Davis
title: Ivan Herrera racks up three hits, runs in 17-1 rout
desc: Ivan Herrera went 3-for-4 in win over the Cubs with three runs scored, two RBI and a walk.
impact: After Friday's win over the Cubs, Herrera is now slashing .258/.396/.406 with 10 homers, 38 RBI, 58 runs scored, five steals, and a .360 wOBA across 85 games. Among qualified catchers, he's second in OBP for the season.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Brice Turang collects three hits in win over Diamondbacks
desc: Brice Turang went 3-for-6 in a win over the Diamondbacks with one run scored and two RBI.
impact: Turang has caught fire again at the plate, recording hits in 10 of his last 12 contests. The infielder continues to offer manager Pat Murphy one of the more impactful bats in a versatile Brewers lineup, carrying an .812 OPS with 12 home runs, 51 RBI, 61 runs scored, and 13 stolen bases through 82 games.

author: Chase Davis
title: Blaze Jordan racks up three hits in rout
desc: Blaze Jordan went 3-for-5 in a win over the Cubs with three runs scored and one strikeout.
impact: After Friday's win over Chicago, Jordan is now slashing .246/.265/.377 with one home run, 13 RBI and eight runs scored across 18 games. He has sat out only one game since being called up, but is going through a rough patch. Through his first 12 games, he batted .286 with five extra-base hits and 12 RBI. In his six games since then, he's batted just .158 with one RBI.
